notes.title: Stability Patch
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Players!  👋[/b][/h1]

Thank you for all the feedback we have been receiving since our last update! Today we are bringing you another patch with a fix that mattered to you the most! 🔨

Last patch we acknowledged that there are ongoing crashes and thanks to you constantly sending us details and crashlogs, we managed to make fixes on various reasons  for it happening. 

[h3][b]So this patch is focused entirely on fixing crashes.[/b][/h3]

This is not the end though! There can be various reasons, and we are aware that all of it may not be fixed, so we asked you kindly to send us more crashlogs, if any occur. With more details of what is happening, so each of you can enjoy Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 in its full glory! 

Everything you send us helps us immensely in improving the game, and we want to thank you for all the dedication you give us. 🔥

[b][u]How to Send Crash Logs[/u]:[/b]
1️⃣ Open the Windows Start menu and type %appdata% into the search bar.
2️⃣ Once the folder appears, navigate back from “Roaming” to the AppData directory.
3️⃣ Go to Local/ShipGraveyard2/Saved/Crashes and locate the most recent folder.
4️⃣ Zip all the files inside that folder.
5️⃣ Send the zipped files to us through the #crashlogs-ticket channel on our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/7b6f700b999e1bcf0ecdd31a52aa0c9cfe25e4a0.png[/img][/url]

See you on the shore!
Ship Graveyard 2 Team

[h3][b]ℹ️ About the New DLC and Ongoing Improvements ℹ️[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Dear Players 🤝[/b][/h3]

We are excited to announce a new DLC for Ship Graveyard Simulator 2, this is another huge step in the game's development. At the same time, we want to address some of the concerns from you - our community regarding some problems in the game and explain the challenges we need to face.

[b][u]Why this DLC is different:[/u][/b]
The upcoming Fishing Boats DLC introduces smaller ships, allowing you to enjoy the full dismantling experience more quickly. Before we gave you bigger ships, which turned out to be problematic on some of the specifications.

Thanks to the smaller size of these ships, game stability, especially in CO-OP Mode.

[b][u]Our Commitment to Improvements:[/u][/b]
We are constantly working on fixes and improvements. However, this process is challenging due to the technical limitations of Unreal Engine 4 but [b]we are now preparing a new huge update to the game, which will be released soon[/b].

When we first designed the game, we did not expect it would attract such a large and passionate community or grow to its current scale.

[b][u]Technical Challenges:[/u][/b]
The largest ships in the game are made up of nearly 100,000 connectors, which puts a heavy load on the game engine.

The average playtime is around 50 hours, which shows how deeply you our players are engaged in the game.

[b][u]Your Support[/u][/b]
We want to thank each and every player for your patience, feedback, and enthusiasm. Your support motivates us to keep improving the game and delivering new content.

We hope this new DLC will bring you even more enjoyment, and we appreciate your understanding as we continue to work on making Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 the best experience possible. 🙌

notes.title: CO-OP PLAYTEST ARE OPEN!
notes.notes:
[h2]We are very pleased to announce that the CO-OP Mode Playtest has just started and are open to everyone! 💥[/h2]


[h2]👇 [u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u] 👇[/h2]
[h3][b]Please remember that these are Playtest of the upcoming version of CO-OP Mode - [u]it is not the final version[/u] - therefore, there may be some gameplay issues and bugs.[/b] [/h3]

If you encounter any bugs or something else, please let us know on Community Hub or our Discord, it will help us to improve the final version of CO-OP - thank you. 


[h3][b]🔶 For players who have signed up earlier[/b] - you can start playing the CO-OP Playtest now.[/h3]

[h3][b]🔶 For players who did not sign up before the start[/b] - first click the "request access" button and then you will automatically get access to the Playtest.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/cece9ff7091de99b50c645877192263955ede73b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][u]Playtest of the CO-OP Mode[/u][/b][/h3]
We decided to Playtest the upcoming CO-OP Mode because we plan to release it for the game in the upcoming 2024 and would like to hear the opinion of our community before we add it to the game. Playtest is something like beta testing, so you can feel like a real QA Tester!

[h3][b]General information[/b][/h3]
The game will have some restrictions against the full version of the game. Read carefully what you can expect! 
[list][*] The server has been limited to 3 players
[*] Available ships are[b] Maroon Lagoon[/b] (connector HP has been reduced) and [b]Caroline[/b]
[*] Players will get more money to start so they can buy both ships plus additional tool upgrades.
[*] For the duration of the playtests, the following will disappear from the game: [/list]- Winche
- Hazard
- Crouching
- Crane upgrades
- Mobile cargo along with input for walkie talkies
- Collectibles 
- Load option
- Continue option
- Credits

[h3][b]Warning:[/b][/h3]
[b]A new player cannot join the game while a ship is ordered! All players must be present before buying a ship[/b]

[h3][b]Known issues:[/b][/h3]
Generally, most things work fine with the game host. However, people who join the game there can be some complications.


[h3][b][u]Suggestions and feedback[/u][/b][/h3]
We encourage you to send your feedback, suggestions, and bugs you may encounter. We will be very pleased if you leave your opinion about the upcoming CO-OP Mode, it is very important to us to listen to the opinions of our community. You can do this by:

[b]1. Steam Community Hub[/b], where we have created appropriate topics. We also encourage you to create your own.
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499529/]📖 CO-OP PLAYTEST | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499655/]🐛 CO-OP PLAYTEST | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url][/list][b]2. On our dedicated Discord[/b] - https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE


[b]3. Directly in the Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Playtest[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2567570/]Steam page[/url]


[h2][b]We can't wait to hear your first impressions! 😊[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Major Update available now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Players! 👋[/h1]

[h3]A free Major Update featuring new gameplay elements is now available for download! 
Check it out and break out a brand new ship, try out mobile cargo and more! 💥 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/736e744c165cb515cafcd253c5149207bb650255.png[/img]


[b]List of news and fixes: [/b]

[list]
[*] New small ship with all new contracts - Slippery Herring
[*] Crane upgrades - players are able to purchase crane upgrades to speed it up
[*] Crane queue - players are able to choose more than one heavy element and queue them
[*] Crouching - new player ability to crouch. Please note that those who own the game and use their own settings must choose the crouching input manually in the settings.
[*] New wiki entries
[*] Mobile cargo - mobile cargo is handy while picking many crates at the same time and throw them inside. Once full, crane picks them all up and stores in the warehouse. Players are able to purchase the cargo in the forge (same as explosives), place it on the level using walkie talkie tool and RMB. Few mobile cargos have been hidden on the ships already.
[*] Sorting place improvements - players can choose auto-sorting option to skip the mini game using 10% of the resources as a fee.
[*] Additionally, the mini game can be paused while sorting. 
[*] Collectibles - there're collectibles to find on all the ships. Once the collectible has been found it'll be stored in the house. They're also full of fun facts.
[*] Celebrations - new "celebrating" animations once the tool upgrade is purchased.
[*] New achievements
[*] Winch improvements
[*] "Lord of the tools" achievement fix
[*] Improvements for picking up and attempt to fix the picking problems
[*] Auto snap improvements
[*] UI improvements
[*] Tutorial fixes
[*] Auto save fixes
[*] Ship fixes
[*] Texts fixes
[*] Gameplay optimisation
[*] Other minor bugfixes
[/list]


[h3][b]Let us know if you like the changes and new features! 👇 Remember that this is not the end of surprises and novelties, there are playtests of COOP mode in Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 coming up! 🎉[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Road Map
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

It’s been a while since the premiere of Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. The amount of feedback you gave us is simply mind blowing and today we’d like to share with you a [b]road map[/b] 🗺️ we’ve prepared so you know [b]the direction our game heads[/b]. With that being said, let’s take a closer look, shall we? 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/1504b0b13cd530894c802972d50c98da66153638.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Gameplay improvement patch[/b][/h3]
As we already said, the amount of feedback was way beyond our expectations and we made sure to read each and every one of them carefully. 👀 The result? [b]A big patch introducing many features you asked for[/b] to better enjoy your time in SGS2! 🧰 

[h3][b]2. “The new types of ships” part 1[/b] [/h3]
We understand that life on the shores of Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 should not be just about the tanker or cargo ships, therefore [b]we’ve decided to add new kinds of ships[/b]!🔥 Let us know in the comments what you think the new kind of ships will be! We can’t wait to see if any of you can guess it!

[h3][b]3. Multiplayer co-op mode[/b][/h3]
[b]The long awaited cooperation mode[/b]. Currently [b]we’re still putting some finishing touches[/b] to make sure you’re going to enjoy dismantling the ships hand in hand with your friends! 😀

[h3][b]4. “The massive ships” update[/b][/h3]
[b]Big crews deserve truly humongous challenges[/b] and we’re going to provide you with one! The ships we’re going to introduce will give you a lot of work, will anyone face the task ahead by themselves? 🤔

[h3][b]5. “The new types of ships” part 2[/b][/h3]
[b]More content, more new ships, even more fun! [/b]🤩 Get ready to explore the new wrecks and face unique problems during the scrapping! 📝

[h3][b]6. Consoles[/b][/h3]
When all the goals are met, we'll release the game on consoles! 🎮 [b]We ask all of our console community for a bit more patience but it’s going to be totally worth it![/b] 🙂

That’s it for today! [b]Hopefully our plan aligns well with your expectations and you’ll keep supporting us throughout the entire process![/b] ⚒️ If you have any ideas, suggestions or wishes [b]we can’t wait to hear from you on our discord[/b] or in the discussions section on Steam!🔥

See you soon
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Team

notes.title: Shopkeepers
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Friends!
[/b][/h1]
[h3]Would you like to hear a story? 🧓 Sit down comfortably and let me tell you a history about my two friends.[/h3]

Once upon a time, there were [b]two brothers[/b], 🧍 🧍 hardworking men who promised to each other that they’ll never shy away from their dreams.

[h3]The older one - [b]Suresh[/b] has always dreamt of running his own shop. 🏪 Eventually, he met the old owner of the Ship Graveyard and [b]started a shop[/b] nearby. It was a [b]very special place[/b] that specialized in [b]buying and reselling various materials[/b]  acquired [b]from dismantled ships[/b] which were highly sought after for construction and maintenance of boats. ⛵[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/5943dd0a48ab5b14d4704efe28c0cd670f80b881.gif[/img]

[h3]The other one, [b]Naresh[/b], was younger and he didn’t share his brother’s passion. Instead he was a [b]very skilled craftsman[/b] 🧑‍🔧who had always helped his brother with upgrading his tools. After many months of being nagged by Suresh, he [b]opened his own business[/b] which covered both [b]upgrading and improving various tools[/b] 🛠️ 🧰 needed to dismantle the ships. [/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/cf6d02dabc08109b7b6a8ff59df7fbb37690a82b.gif[/img]

Brothers were smart and the money 💵 one earned by selling the materials to Suresh was quickly landing in Naresh’s pocket anyway, since many people recognized the value of his craftsmanship and constantly sought to invest in better equipment. 

I wonder if they still work and run those places. Maybe one day you’ll even meet them yourself.


[h2][b]We can already answer this question! YES[/b][/h2]

[h3]The brothers will come to meet you in our [b]Ship Graveyard Simulator 2[/b] 🚢 game, but the meeting will not end there. [b]You will be [/b][b]regular customers[/b] to their stores!
[/h3]

[h2]Suresh will let you earn money from the ship parts you dismantle, and you will [b]use the money to upgrade[/b] [b]and buy  tools[/b] in the store run by Naresh! 
[/h2]

Prosperous family business ;) 

[h1] 🛠️Tools of better quality and power will allow you to reduce your working time ⌚ and more.[/h1]

We [b]value your ideas and opinions[/b] a lot so hopefully, you’ll let us know what would you like to see in the game. You can do so in the [b]comment section[/b] of this devlog or on our [b]discord[/b]. 👇 Make sure to [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] to never miss on any information.

notes.title: Truck n’ sortin’🤠
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Ship Graveyard keepers![/b] 👋[/h1]
Today we are going to be talking about the addition of a [b]truck[/b] to the game and also a new mechanic which is [b]sorting[/b] what you’ve gathered!😮

Here’s how’s it gonna look:
[previewyoutube=SyN3UNQfBRY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]The truck[/b]🚚[/h1]
The [b]truck[/b] is an essential tool used while dismantling a [b]ship[/b]. After you collect the materials from the ship, you throw them in the back of the [b]truck[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/d95067c398794ea56ac05fa6b5263c71c39a502d.jpg[/img]

After filling up the trunk you can drive to the sorting place to sort the items you’ve picked up. You can drive the [b]truck[/b] with the camera in the [b]first person mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/b3fe9704f54091b61cfc1703c941261889756f3a.jpg[/img]
or [b]third person point of view[/b], which changes the feeling of the drive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/22ea60c615cbf153a8dbd3ccea65e24dbdab5c22.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The Sorting[/b]🧐[/h1]
There are four categories of materials which you will be able to salvage from the ships:[b] metals, non-metals, fluids and props.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/afe99679d9dad8f6a3b60feca736a2cc81b20074.jpg[/img]
All of which you can [b]sort[/b] after collecting them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/6339ca16699316b7f9054e33bf0b3fa067276755.jpg[/img]
After delivering the materials to the [b]sorting place[/b] there is an option to leave without sorting them, it will however result in losing a lot of valuable materials which you can find on the [b]ship[/b]. You can sell salvaged and [b]sorted[/b] materials, or use them for upgrades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/f21480a063319ed53c8c36424d6470cdf6230c1e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The End[/b]⌚[/h1]

notes.title: Destroying the WHOLE ship in Ship Graveyard 2 🥳
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Gravekeepers![/b] 😈[/h1]
First of all, the thing we all know you want to see; how it looks in action, so here it is!😎

[previewyoutube=x_23gq0Uvgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]The Mechanics of Destroying Entire Ships[/b]🎆[/h1]

The elements of the [b]ship[/b] have a certain amount of connectors⛓ that you need to [b]destroy[/b] for the desired part of the [b]ship[/b] to be demolished.😮

When several elements next to each other no longer have any [b]connectors[/b] breaking the element will cause a chain reaction making it so the next parts of the [b]ship[/b] will fall as well.🛳

In case that the elements of the [b]ship[/b] have no foundations connecting them with the rest of the boat they will fall in their entirety.⚓

[h1][b]The Downside[/b]🤔
[/h1]Demolishing a lot of the elements will however make it so you will lose resources you are otherwise able to collect from the broken parts.🚢

[h1][b]The Wait[/b]⌚
[/h1]We know that you’ve been waiting for this one a long time and we are really happy that we are finally able to make your dreams come true!🤗

[h3]It's been over a year since the premiere of the first part of the game, thank you for being with us and creating an amazing community around the game. Today we are very pleased to announce that we are working on [b]Ship Graveyard Simulator 2![/b]🔥[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/95c74c411c269bc0528eb5b822617853666b2824.png[/img]

[h3]We're soooooo excited to show you a sneak peek of the upcoming second part of the game! And this is just the beginning, watch the trailer of the upcoming [b]Ship Graveyard Simulator 2[/b]![/h3]

[previewyoutube=Q4DBG1z0xf0;full][/previewyoutube]
[u]Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 means not only a new game but also a new dev team! A few words from new dev them:[/u]
"[i]Hello Players,

We are a completely new team that will create Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 for you. We have been looking at your ideas and suggestions for several months, which you write on Community Hub and Discord, and it is an amazing database for us as the developers of the second part of the game. We have always known that listening to the community is a step in the right direction. You players showed us not only an amazing passion for the game but also provided new ideas, and suggestions - thank you for that!

We also know the problems you encountered in the first part of the game and we will try to eliminate them all. We assure you that the game will feature a full disassembly of ships, large ships - we mean really colossal ships - and there will be some interesting new gameplay features, but also well-known mechanics from the first game that have been significantly improved - so, it doesn't matter if you're a veteran in the game or for the first time you will have a hammer in your hands, you will get into this business.

The dev team from the first part will of course support us with their knowledge and skills. We hope that we will meet your expectations for the second part of the game, be sure to write to us on the Community Hub and on the new Discord channel, we are waiting for you.

So, let's start a new amazing adventure together, it's time to get back to the business.[/i]"
